text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's the end of today's routine.
Good work out there!
choice_data_list: Good work. Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're right. ...Well then, once we get back,
I'll take a nice, relaxing bath and—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, let's do a match race!
On your mark, get set—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Gran-chan.
—She pulled off a clean start, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She's in a good position.
Her tempo is good, too.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're running your own race out there.
Yeah, you're really running your own race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(It depends on the lineup, but...
judging by that running style,
it looks like I'll end up trailing from behind.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
4th corner... moved to the outside.
—Right here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(What acceleration!
Is her burst even sharper than the last time I saw it?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (This is—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer. Do you mind if I do a little more training after all?
choice_data_list: Huh? You're done for the day already...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That was the plan, but
Gran-chan's run just now—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat that running.
No—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose.
For some reason, I absolutely don't want to lose."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I could go ask for a tandem run.
choice_data_list: If you want to win, you need to rest.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me, Eye-senpai!
I look forward to our tandem training!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Likewise!
Are the same conditions as before fine with you?
...1600m on Turf, counter-clockwise.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
...I'm not giving up the mile to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Yes, I'm fine—I won't back down either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To win when they eventually clash head-to-head,
she needs to rest today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That is... quite true, yes.
Unforeseen fatigue is a scary thing later on, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, my head's cooled down now.
...Yeah, let's just call it a day!
